mdcalc_rules: Age <=40:0, 41-60:+1, 61-74:+2, >=75:+3. Sex Male/Female (no points; the static page shows no female-only items, and no note mentions pregnancy, postpartum or OCP/HRT). Type of surgery (pick one): none 0, minor +1, major >45 min / laparoscopic >45 min / arthroscopic +2, elective major lower-extremity arthroplasty +5. Recent (<1 month) events: major surgery +1, CHF +1, sepsis +1, pneumonia +1, immobilizing plaster cast +2, hip/pelvis/leg fracture +5, stroke +5, multiple trauma +5, acute spinal cord injury causing paralysis +5. Venous disease/clotting: varicose veins +1, current swollen legs +1, current central venous access +2, History of DVT/PE (ONE combined item) +3, family history of thrombosis +3, Factor V Leiden +3, prothrombin 20210A +3, elevated homocysteine +3, lupus anticoagulant +3, elevated anticardiolipin Ab +3, HIT +3, other congenital/acquired thrombophilia +3. Mobility (pick one): normal/out of bed 0, medical patient currently on bed rest +1, confined to bed >72 h +2. Bed rest means unable to walk 30 ft (10 m) at one time; bathroom privileges or walking in the room do not count as ambulation. Other: IBD +1, BMI >25 +1, acute MI +1, COPD +1, present or previous malignancy +2, other risk factors +1.

code_vs_mdcalc.issue: Code scores previous DVT (+3) and previous PE (+3) separately, so a patient with both gets +6. MDCalc has one combined 'History of DVT/PE' item worth +3.
MDCalc's 'Other risk factors' (+1) item is missing from the code. No row uses it.

Interface mismatch: caprini_score() takes surgery_type_value and mobility_value, but name_to_python maps to surgery_type and mobility, so caprini_score(**inputs) raises TypeError on every row. Labels come from caprini_score_explanation(), which gives the same totals. No label impact.
Cosmetic: when surgery_type is absent, the explanation indexes a plain string (param_full_name['surgery_type'][0]) and prints 'does not report anything about s'. It still adds 0 points.
Cosmetic: BMI exactly 25 is printed as 'less than 25'. Scoring is correct (>25 required).

Point values, age bands, surgery-type strings (none/minor/major/laparoscopic/arthroscopic/elective major lower extremity arthroplasty), mobility strings (normal/on bed rest/confined to bed >72 hours) and BMI >25 all match MDCalc. Female-only items are not modelled, and no row needs them.
